iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 46. US-Iran 2-week ceasefire holding but fragile (CNN). Iran 10-point peace plan under negotiation. Iran demands enrichment acceptance + sanction relief. Trump pulled back threats for 2-week window. Iranian negotiators in Islamabad for talks. 440kg 60% HEU still at Isfahan. IAEA withdrawn. Democracy Now: war may be turning Iran into major world power. Diplomatic: MEDIUM. Technical: CRITICAL. Probability DOWN to 40%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 46. CRITICAL: Iran re-closed Strait of Hormuz after Israel Lebanon strikes (AP). CNN: truce on shaky ground. Iran FM says passage allowed for 2 weeks under Iranian military management but reality differs. Sky News: will strait ever fully reopen? Oil tanker turned away. Euronews: ceasefire threatened. Trump still holding back on widening attacks. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 32%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 46. ESCALATING: Israel struck 100+ targets in 10 minutes across Lebanon (AP) - largest wave since March 1. 250+ killed, 1500+ total dead (AP/Democracy Now). 1.1M displaced. Israel explicitly REJECTED ceasefire for Lebanon. Netanyahu: ceasefire with Iran will not include Hezbollah. Hezbollah RESUMED rocket fire. 400+ Hezbollah fighters killed per Reuters. UK/France calling for ceasefire. Trump calls Lebanon separate skirmish. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 72%. RISING. Most volatile zone.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: NATO Steadfast Dart-2026 exercise ongoing. Patriot battery at Malatya. OSW confirms Turkey pursuing strategic ambiguity on nuclear weapons. FM Fidan: Iran ambitions could push Turkey into nuclear arms race. Akkuyu nuclear plant commissioning. B61-12 transition excludes Turkey. Stable at 11%.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: ESCALATORY: Pakistan Defence Minister Asif warns space for war between nuclear states is inconceivable - sharp nuclear signaling. CFR rates renewed India-Pakistan conflict as Tier II contingency (moderate risk). Pahalgam anniversary approaching - potential trigger. India rejects US mediation. Pakistan engaging Iran/Egypt in parallel talks. Rhetoric: HIGH. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 20%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 46. Iran war = strategic windfall for Russia (Axios/WaPo): surging oil, diverted Western attention, strained NATO. Putin warns nuclear war with NATO risk. Trump-Rutte meeting confirmed NATO HOLDS. Rutte NATO speech Apr 9 backs Hormuz mission. Russia approaching 2026 NPT Review with significant disagreements. Medvedev nuclear threats continue. Strategic Rocket Forces 90% modernized. Probability DOWN slightly to 57%. Stable.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING TECHNICAL: CNN investigation confirms China secretly expanding nuclear weapons infrastructure + testing new generation warheads. Asia Times: China conducting nuclear-response drills for Taiwan war scenario. DPP promoting $40B drone procurement (200K systems). KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun Beijing visit. Taiwan Warns of China Hybrid Tactics (Apr 8). Taiwan military warns budget delay threatens $2.4B weapons. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: HIGH. Probability UP to 12%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: 3RD missile launch in 2 days (Apr 8) - multiple SRBMs from Wonsan, 240km each (Euronews/AP/UPI). VP FM Jang Kum-chol: South Korea most hostile enemy state, world-startling fools. Kim observed cruise missile test from new destroyer. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Kim demands US nuclear recognition. 38 North: solid-propellant ICBM (Hwasong-18), tactical nukes, LACMs all probably deployed. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Technical: CRITICAL. Stable at 88%.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1140+. Arms Control: Russia concocting Ukrainian bomb claims - potential pretext for nuclear escalation. Kremlin warns of potential threat of Ukraine acquiring nuclear weapons. New START expired Feb 2026, no replacement. Full arms race per Bulletin. ISW Apr 8: Ukrainian strikes on Russian assets in Donetsk continue. Carnegie: Russia faces hostile countries Kola to Black Sea. Medvedev nuclear threats continue. Probability DOWN slightly to 81%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: DIPLOMATIC BREAKTHROUGH SUSTAINED: China-hosted Urumqi talks ongoing (AP/Al Jazeera/Bloomberg). Both sides committed to ceasefire. China actively mediating per FM spokesperson Mao Ning. Pakistan-Afghanistan agreed to avoid escalation and explore comprehensive solution. VP Vance delegation heading to Islamabad this weekend. Sporadic mortar incidents continue but at lower intensity. Diplomatic: HIGH. Probability DOWN to 7%. Falling.
